subject.title: [Security] Plaintext credential leakage in diagnostic crash dumps

question: Which disclosure-safe serialized log shape should be accepted as the canonical reproduction for this diagnostics-export report?
rationale: The protected security signal requires human triage, while the report omits the concrete encoding needed to verify exposure and safely choose recursion limits.

options.title: Request canary artifact

options.title: Run internal encoding matrix
